## Goal
Keep hook run throw/ok:false behavior as warnings and issue-log candidates after snapshot validation succeeds.

## Acceptance Criteria

- R3 and AC6 are covered for ok:false hook returns.
- Warning schema remains PLUGIN_HOOK_FAILED-style and includes plugin id, command, hook, and message.

## Implementation Notes

## Test Strategy
